WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
)
SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit 
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', s_store_id) AS id, ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, ss_net_profit AS profit, sr_net_loss AS profit_loss 
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store ON store_sk = s_store_sk
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_date)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', s_store_id) AS id, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit, sr_net_loss AS profit_loss 
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN store ON sr_store_sk = s_store_sk
    WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_date)
) salesreturns
GROUP BY ROLLUP(channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id 
LIMIT 100
